show: In the 88th minute, Barcelona needed three more goals.
say: In the eighty-eighth minute, Barcelona needed three more goals.

show: Three weeks earlier, in Paris, they had lost 4–0.
say: Three weeks earlier, in Paris, they had lost four nil.

show: Before the second leg, Luis Enrique said: if they can score four, we can score six.
say: Before the second leg, Luis Enrique said, if they can score four, we can score six.

show: By 50 minutes, it was 3–0. Suárez. An own goal. Messi from the spot.
say: By fifty minutes, it was three nil. Suarez. An own goal. Messi, from the spot.

show: Then Cavani scored. One away goal, and Barcelona needed three more.
say: Then Cavani scored. One away goal, and Barcelona needed three more.

show: With two minutes left, it was still 3–1.
say: With two minutes left, it was still three, one.

show: Still not enough. The 95th minute. One last ball into the box.
say: Still not enough. The ninety-fifth minute. One last ball, into the box.

show: 6–1. 6–5 on aggregate. The biggest comeback in Champions League history.
say: Six, one. Six, five on aggregate. The biggest comeback in Champions League history.
